name: Statistics charts
description: Scatter plots with best-fit curves, histograms, box plots, heat maps and radar charts, drawn from your spreadsheets and document tables.
author: Daevu

boards.name: Scatter plot
boards.hint: Points on two axes, with bubbles and best-fit curves.

boards.name: Histogram
boards.hint: How values spread out, with mean and a normal curve.

boards.name: Box plot
boards.hint: Median, quartiles and outliers for each column.

boards.name: Heat map
boards.hint: A grid of numbers shaded from low to high.

boards.name: Radar chart
boards.hint: Compare several measures at once on spokes.
